title: Canonical locally closed scalar-perfect generators
statement: For a commutative condensed ring Λ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and a finite-type k-scheme X [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], a scalar-perfect generator [def-sfb-locally-perfect-scalar-model] is an object isomorphic to i_!P, for some locally closed immersion i:S→X and P pro-etale locally the constant scalar realization of a bounded finite-projective Λ(*)-complex. Here i_! is specifically D(openImmersionLowerShriek Λ i.toImage) followed by R(lowerStar Λ i.imageι); the second functor uses restriction along the published coefficient adjunct [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek, sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. These are the original definitions from scalarSixCtf, factored into their own data module with unchanged bodies. The coefficient rings and the scalar change functor are those of [def-sfb-scalar-six-coefficient-interfaces].
